verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page states that Pipelines can run CI/CD workflows on hosted runners, private runners, or both, with centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies and deployment environments. This matches every element of the story, though the only support is marketing copy. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on private runner setup and management, detail on what the centralized visibility dashboard shows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
